twitter.title: CFB Gagetown fire: the full sequence
twitter.description: Artillery into the Lawfield Impact Area, reported to Range Control at 12:22 p.m., seen from orbit 24 minutes later, still burning a day on.

image_alts.01-cfb-gagetown-fire-region.jpg: Satellite map of the lower Saint John River valley showing Fredericton, Oromocto and Gagetown village, with the Oct. 28, 2026 fire marked in the CFB Gagetown training area
image_alts.02-cfb-gagetown-fire-locator.jpg: Satellite map of the CFB Gagetown training area with VIIRS fire detections of Oct. 28, 2026 clustered in a large open clearing west-south-west of Gagetown village
image_alts.03-cfb-gagetown-fire-closeup.jpg: Close-up satellite image of the clearing with 35 VIIRS fire-detection boxes from five satellite passes on Oct. 28, 2026
image_alts.04-cfb-gagetown-fire-swir.jpg: Short-wave infrared satellite view of the same clearing, showing the fire detections on dry, sparsely vegetated ground
image_alts.08-cfb-gagetown-fire-3d-from-north.jpg: 3D view of the CFB Gagetown clearing from the north, with spikes showing the heat output of each satellite fire detection
image_alts.09-cfb-gagetown-fire-timeline.jpg: Chart of fire radiative power over CFB Gagetown from GOES-19 and VIIRS on Oct. 28–29, 2026, with the base's reported times marked
